title: High selectivity of CO2 capture with single- and double-walled carbon nanotubes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00496E, Paper
Winarto, Lilis Yuliati, Purnami, Paul E. Brumby, Kenji Yasuoka
CNTs prefer to adsorb CO2 instead of N2, resulting in a separation effect for flue gas. CO2 forms solid ice structure in the CNTs that enhance the separation effect.
